tools.name: list_space_templates
tools.title: Search space templates
tools.description: Retrieve the list of available Space Templates with their basic information.

query.description: Keyword search across space names and descriptions

tools.name: get_space_template_by_id
tools.title: Get a space template
tools.description: Retrieve a Space Template using its technical identifier.

tools.name: create_space
tools.title: Create a space
tools.description: Creates a new Space for the current user based on a template. IMPORTANT: to create a SUB-SPACE under an existing space, you MUST set parent_space_id to that parent space's id (first look it up with get_my_spaces or get_all_spaces). Creating a space without parent_space_id always makes a TOP-LEVEL space, even if the user asked for a sub-space. A sub-space can only be created when the parent space's template explicitly allows it.

space_template_id.description: Template ID of the space (required). Use 'listSpaceTemplates' Tool to find valid IDs and Search for a Space Template by its name.

name.description: User-facing display name of the space

registration.description: How users can join the space

parent_space_id.description: Identifier of the parent space, REQUIRED to create a sub-space (7.2 hierarchy). Set this whenever the user asks for a 'sub-space of X' / a space 'under X' — resolve X's id first via get_my_spaces or get_all_spaces. Omit only for a genuine top-level space.

tools.name: update_space_settings
tools.title: Update a space settings
tools.description: Update the settings of an existing Space.

space_id.description: Identifier of the Space to update

tools.name: get_activity

tools.description: Get a single activity (Also Known As 'post') by its ID.

tools.name: create_activity
tools.title: Post an activity
tools.description: Create a new activity (Also Known As 'post') in a space activity stream (or personal activity stream if space_id is null).

tools.name: create_activity_with_image
tools.title: Post an activity with an image
tools.description: Create an activity (post) in a space (or the personal stream if space_id is null) and attach an image to it. The image comes from either a public image URL or base64-encoded bytes (e.g. a screenshot). Use create_activity when no image is needed.

image_url.description: Direct http(s) URL of an image to attach. Provide either image_url or image_base64 (not both).

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (png, jpeg, gif or webp), optionally as a data: URI. Use for a locally-produced image such as a screenshot; prefer image_url when the image is reachable by URL. Provide either image_url or image_base64 (not both).

attachment_object_type.description: Internal: object type of an existing platform attachment to use as the image (set automatically by the client from the user's attached image — do not fill this yourself). Read as the current user, so its ACL is enforced.

attachment_object_id.description: Internal: object id of an existing platform attachment to use as the image (set automatically by the client — do not fill this yourself). Provide exactly one image source: attachment_object_id, image_url or image_base64.

alt_text.description: Optional accessibility description of the image.

attachment_object_type.description: Internal: object type of an existing platform attachment to use as the image (set automatically by the client from the user's attached image — do not fill this yourself). Read as the current user, so its ACL is enforced.

attachment_object_id.description: Internal: object id of an existing platform attachment to use as the image (set automatically by the client — do not fill this yourself). Provide exactly one image source: attachment_object_id, image_url or image_base64.

alt_text.description: Optional accessibility description of the image.

tools.name: get_category_tree
tools.title: Get the contents categorization tree
tools.description: get the available categories tree (including sub categories) which can be associated any type of content identified by its technical identifier. The returned category will describe either current user can manage contents association to the category (add/remove contents to the category) through the attribute `can_add_content`.

tools.name: get_categories_of_content
tools.title: Get categories of a content
tools.description: get the associated categories to a designated content. The returned category will describe either current user can manage contents association to the category (add/remove contents to the category) through the attribute `can_add_content`.

content_type.description: Content Type: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`. Use the tool `get_content_types` to list them all if you don't know the exact content type name.

content_id.description: Content Id: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`

tools.name: add_content_to_category
tools.title: Associate  a category to a content
tools.description: Add a content into a category. The current user must have the permission (see `can_add_content` attribute in the category) to be able to make the operation on his/her behalf.

content_type.description: Content Type: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`. Use the tool `get_content_types` to list them all if you don't know the exact content type name.

content_id.description: Content Id: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`

tools.name: remove_content_from_category
tools.title: Remove a category to a content
tools.description: Removes a content from an associated category. The current user must have the permission (see `can_add_content` attribute in the category) to be able to make the operation on his/her behalf.

content_type.description: Content Type: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`. Use the tool `get_content_types` to list them all if you don't know the exact content type name.

content_id.description: Content Id: can be extracted from expressions like `/{content_type}:{content_id}`

tools.name: set_my_avatar
tools.title: Set my profile avatar
tools.description: Set the current user's profile picture (avatar) from an image. The image comes from a public image URL or base64-encoded bytes (e.g. a generated image). Applies to the current user only.

image_url.description: Direct http(s) URL of an image. Provide either image_url or image_base64 (not both).

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (png, jpeg, gif or webp), optionally as a data: URI. Use for a locally-produced image such as a screenshot; prefer image_url when the image is reachable by URL. Provide either image_url or image_base64 (not both).

attachment_object_type.description: Internal: object type of an existing platform attachment to use as the image (set automatically by the client from the user's attached image — do not fill this yourself). Read as the current user, so its ACL is enforced.

attachment_object_id.description: Internal: object id of an existing platform attachment to use as the image (set automatically by the client — do not fill this yourself). Provide exactly one image source: attachment_object_id, image_url or image_base64.
